reference.question: Show names of teachers that teach at least two courses.
reference.gold_sql: SELECT T2.Name FROM course_arrange AS T1 JOIN teacher AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID = T2.Teacher_ID GROUP BY T2.Name HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
